detail: Every market value in this project comes from nflverse games.csv. The publisher does not state the operator or the snapshot time, so our comparison cannot distinguish an opening line from a closing line.
action: Published as AGGREGATOR; gates G4 and G8 recorded as failed; suggestion S01 addresses it.

detail: No official NFL or operator source publishes historical closing lines with timestamps, so CLV cannot be computed from official data.
action: G4 marked failed for every strategy; no strategy is certified.

detail: Prop legs are evaluated at median splits and by correlation, not against real prices, because no official prop-line archive exists.
action: Correlation coefficients published; economic evaluation withheld.

detail: The Thursday snapshot of the official Week 10 report lists 276 players but only 6 carry a game status (Out/Doubtful/Questionable); the rest are practice-only.
action: Practice-status weights applied and labelled provisional; the page is refreshed later in the week.

item: Depth strings are inferred, not official
detail: The NFL does not publish machine-readable depth charts. Depth strings (1st-4th) are computed from season-to-date snap share within team and position group.
action: Method and thresholds published; role unknown for players without a snap profile.

item: Six clubs report no injuries on the snapshot
detail: The official page lists 26 clubs on the Thursday snapshot; the remaining six pages show no reported injuries rather than missing data.
action: Teams with zero listed rows are shown as zero, not as missing, and flagged here.

item: Club code mismatch: LA vs LAR
detail: nflverse uses LA for the Rams and teams.csv uses LAR; joins would silently drop the Rams without an alias.
action: Alias applied in the audit; documented in the crosscheck table.

item: Prior session's home-underdog claims do not reproduce
detail: Recomputing with documented conventions gives home underdogs 49.7% ATS (prior: 52.6%) and home dogs of +7 or more 54.0% over 730 bets (prior: 56.4% over 793). Both sources in this repo agree with the new numbers.
action: Prior figures flagged; the new figures are used on the site and the discrepancy is left for human review.

item: Prior QB/WR1 correlation of 0.76 does not reproduce
detail: On 2024-2026 weekly stats the correlation between a QB's passing yards and his team's top receiver's yards is 0.50 (n=1,255). The prior 0.76 came from a play-by-play extract through 2020 and a different WR1 definition.
action: Both figures published; the newer, larger-sample figure is used for SGP pricing.

item: Prior luck figure of 20.8% does not reproduce
detail: Exact binomial probability of 110+ wins in 200 bets at a 52.38% rate is 25.1%, not 20.8%. The prior derivation is not documented.
action: Exact calculation published with the formula; prior figure flagged.

item: Sign-convention error caught in this session
detail: The first injury backtest used the spread with the wrong sign and reported a 57.4% ATS edge. After correction the same strategy is 51.4% (p=1.0). The erroneous run is retained in the audit trail.
action: Sign convention documented; regression test suggested (S02).

detail: Snap counts, weekly stats, injury mirrors and lines all come from one mirror project. A drift there would propagate into every number.
action: Dual-source assertions proposed (S09); official pages are parsed where possible.

item: Week 10 market lines are not verified against an operator page
detail: The current-week market cells are aggregator values; no operator page snapshot was captured for Week 10.
action: Market cells labelled AGGREGATOR and the model-versus-market edge is described as provisional.

detail: Out/Doubtful/Questionable = 1.0/0.75/0.5 and DNP/Limited/Full = 0.5/0.25/0.0 are assumptions, not published probabilities.
action: Assumptions listed in the methodology and in injury_signal.json; empirical fitting proposed (S07).

detail: 2026 contributes 136 completed games to a 950-game calibration sample; per-season slopes range from -0.035 to -0.131 points per percentage point.
action: Per-season results published rather than a single pooled number.

item: No machine-readable official depth chart exists
detail: Club websites publish depth charts in inconsistent formats; the league does not publish a structured feed.
action: Snap-share inference used; documented as an inference.

detail: The Munich game is a Detroit home game; the model sets home-field advantage to zero for it. The size of that assumption is not measured.
action: Published in the line table; Q14 tracks it.

item: Mirror freshness for the current week
detail: The mirror's Week 10 injury rows matched the official page 276/276 at retrieval, but the mirror can lag later updates.
